content: <thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak at m/z 127.0997 likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈126.092 Da. The formula that best matches this mass within typical analytical tolerance is C₈H₁₄O (exact mass 126.104 Da, ~95 ppm difference, the closest simple formula among common C/H/O candidates). No other heteroatoms are indicated by the spectrum, so the molecular formula is reported as C8H14O.
